title: 3D Einstein action from 6D Kodaira-Spencer gravity
summary: In view of embedding 3D gravity into topological string theory, we show that the dimensional reduction of 6D Kodaira-Spencer gravity on $\text{AdS}_3\times S^3$, i.e. the low-energy description of twisted holography, contains a subsector that coincides with the action of chiral 3D gravity on $\text{AdS}_3$. Furthermore, we show that the full 3D Einstein action is obtained as the reduction of two independent complex-conjugate copies of 6D Kodaira-Spencer gravity.
